clips.title: The story
paras: At Iris Lake, Shael'dryn entrusts you with Dartol's Rod of Transformation, restored for Raene Wolfrunner in Astranaar. You carry it back to report success and honor Teronis, the fallen scout.

Dartol's Rod of Transformation has been reforged with components and ancient gem fragments gathered from corrupted reaches of Ashenvale. Near Iris Lake, the dryad Shael'dryn cleanses and renews its magic, then sends you across the forest roads to Astranaar. Raene Wolfrunner awaits the restored artifact.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: I suggest you find Raene and let her know the rod is finished. I'm sure she'll know what your next course should be.

clips.title: Completion
paras: You've recreated the rod Teronis had set out to find? That's wonderful to hear.
Teronis would be proud to see his quest is continuing even after his tragic passing.
